{{Quote|Asylum is a skyport. A safe haven from Arcann's patrols.|[[Senya Tirall]]|<ref name="Chapter 5">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=5}}</ref>}}
'''Asylum''' was a [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] located in the atmosphere of a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

==History==
Asylum became a sanctuary for refugees fleeing the tyranny of the [[Eternal Empire]] on [[Zakuul]] following the [[Eternal Empire conquest|war of conquest]] that toppled the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Among the refugees were the [[Scions of Zakuul]] and their leader, [[Heskal]], who had fled the purges instituted by Emperor [[Arcann]]. Following the rescue of [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]] from Zakuul in [[3631 BBY]], former Zakuulan officer [[Koth Vortena]] and his compatriots - [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Lana Beniko]], renegade [[Knights of Zakuul|Knight of Zakuul]] [[Senya Tirall]], and the bodyguard droid [[HK-55]] - fled Zakuul onboard the ''[[Gravestone]]'', an ancient combat frigate that had been able to fight against the [[Eternal Fleet]], and docked at Asylum for repairs.<ref name="Chapter 6">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=6}}</ref>

Guided by visions in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and believing a confrontation was required, Heskal lured Arcann to Asylum by telling him that the Outlander who had escaped him was there, resulting in a [[Battle of Asylum|battle]] between the Outlander's forces and the Eternal Fleet, and a duel between the Outlander and Arcann in the station's control tower. Though weakened by the battle, the Outlander escaped with the ''Gravestone'' and its crew and fled to [[Odessen]], laying the foundation for an [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against Arcann.<ref name="Chapter 8" /><ref name="Chapter 9">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=9}}</ref>
